Chapter 755: Chapter 34: Through the Ages (8000 words, please subscribe)_5

“`

Advance another step at the top of the hundred-foot pole, how easy is that to say?

“Don’t worry, I’ve already discussed it with the other Supreme Beings.”

“If it really doesn’t work in the end, we’ll use the Ancestral Force to see if we can forcefully break through that ‘White Paper.'”

The Xia Qin Supreme Being said solemnly.

Ever since the ‘White Paper’ squeezed into the universe, the Xia Qin Supreme Being and other existences have been carefully probing without using any drastic measures.

...

The first reason is the fear of causing more changes in the ‘White Paper.’

The second is to avoid damaging the ‘White Paper’ as much as possible.

But now, with all the probing methods proving ineffective, there’s only the option of breaking through by force left.

“Thank you, Supreme Being.” Lin Yuan said.

The Ancestral Force of Human Civilization definitely should not be used lightly, especially in the face of the ‘White Paper’ whose details are unknown.

But Lin Yuan is too important to Human Civilization, and the nine Supreme Beings, including Xia Qin, didn’t want to see Lin Yuan’s Avatar fall in the Two-dimensional World and suffer fundamental losses.

…

Leaving the personal world of the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan’s True Body then continued to sense the rule fluctuations.

“Out of the twelve Guiding Spaces on the black planet, I have taken ten.” Lin Yuan mused. In the recent two to three years, he had gradually deduced three more Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

At Lin Yuan’s level, it was easy to deduce Pillar-level Fusion Rules. The difficult part was cultivating these Pillar-level Fusion Rules to a higher Realm.

Lin Yuan’s first comprehended Life and Death Samsara Rule still hovered at the Second Realm, and even with the assistance of the black planet’s Guiding Spaces, it was still a short distance from the Third Realm.

“I am still too greedy.”

Lin Yuan shook his head lightly, forgetting that he was only at the Tenth Rank.

The ultimate goal of a Tenth Rank strong person probably is just to comprehend one Pillar-level Fusion Rule and rank as Grade A.

Yet now, speaking of Pillar-level Fusion Rules, Lin Yuan could deduce them as he wished, and the Pillar-level rules he deduced were powerful Fusion Rules merged from more than three pillar rules.

…

Virtual World.

Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, found Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy Master, you really should go take a look at Heavenly Mountain.” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, couldn’t help but say.

At the peak of Heavenly Mountain, when the celestial gate opened, Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, searched for Lin Yuan among many Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses but couldn’t find him.

So, it was assumed that Lin Yuan didn’t go to Heavenly Mountain.

And that was quite normal.

Not all Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses would venture to Heavenly Mountain.

For example, the powerful members of the Tianyu Clan hardly went to Heavenly Mountain.

And some Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who knew they had no hope of entering the celestial gate did not go to Heavenly Mountain either.

In Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master’s view, Lin Yuan was likely among the latter, and as the most powerful genius in the history of Human Civilization, his appearance at Heavenly Mountain would probably attract the attention of other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses and thereby cause unnecessary trouble.

“The ‘Blood Rain’ figure of our Human Civilization went on a killing spree at the peak of Heavenly Mountain, crushing supreme special beings like the Four Divine Kings into the dust, tsk tsk…”

Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, spoke with a tone of emotion, and even now, the scenes from the peak of Heavenly Mountain kept flashing through his mind.

It was just too domineering.

Could the Evolvers of Human Civilization actually be so dominant in the presence of those unique and special existences?

“Hmm…”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Without offering much explanation.

For a Tenth Rank being to thrash the Tier 11 Perfect special beings like the Four Divine Kings, if such news were to spread out, it would definitely cause the pinnacle figures of the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan to lose sleep.

Rather than that, it’s better to keep it under wraps, which was also the advice given by the Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Until one has sufficient strength, it is best to lay low.

It’s not that Human Civilization couldn’t offer protection, but it would save a lot of trouble.

Human Civilization, too, grew to its current strength through a long period of laying low.

“I wonder which Evolver of Human Civilization the ‘Blood Rain’ is and if I have the privilege to meet them…”

Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, said with a hint of longing in his voice. He was also an Eleventh-Rank Evolver, but he didn’t dare to feel any pride in the presence of the ‘Blood Rain’ figure.

“Meet the ‘Blood Rain’?”

Lin Yuan glanced at Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master.

Without saying anything.

…

Two-dimensional World.

After a short period of seclusion, Lin Yuan took the initiative to leave the Luochuan gathering area and began to travel around every corner of the Two-dimensional World.

Past the Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm, simple seclusion no longer had much effect on strength improvement.

What Lin Yuan needed to do was to walk every place in the Two-dimensional World, to observe the essence of its power from different angles, continuously break the constraints of the world, and further improve his strength.

Years flowed gently by.

After that, Lin Yuan never showed up again, having traversed each phase of the twelve Ancient Countries and eventually leaving their territories, exploring towards the even more vast desolate regions.

Atop the mountain ranges.

In the depths of the wilderness.

Beneath the vast seas.

Lin Yuan passed by, as if an observer detached from the world.

Time flowed like water, and before he knew it, ten thousand years had passed.
